<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Unexpected damage.

'''Card text:''' At the beginning of a battle at a location where two or more opposing characters and one or more weapons are deployed, an accident occurs. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of opposing characters at that location, one of them is lost; the opposing player chooses which character.

'''Lore:''' Even Rebel soldiers fully equipped with blast vests and helmets with blast shields cannot remain unharmed on a battlefield where grenades burst and panels explode.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a location where opposing characters and weapons are deployed; the English refers to a site where the opponent has those cards. The Japanese title means unexpected damage.
